24200.name: The Sphere Room

east.description: To the east lies The Steamy Hallway.

up.description: To the up lies Inside A Dark Cave.

24200.description:
A great sphere of dull red crystal fills the middle of this round
chamber, pulsing slowly like a heartbeat. Heat rolls off it in waves and
beads the curved walls with moisture. Scorch marks ring the floor in
widening circles around its base. A narrow, rough climb leads up toward
a dark cave, and the only other way out is an arched opening east into a
steamy hallway.

extra_descs.sphere crystal:
The sphere is smooth, glassy and as tall as a man, glowing from within
with a sullen red light. Its surface hums when touched, and the palm
comes away hot.

24201.name: The Steamy Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Turn In The Steamy Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Sphere Room.

24201.description:
Steam curls off the flagstones of this long hallway and gathers on the
walls until it runs down in thin streaks. The air tastes of iron and wet
stone. Empty torch brackets line the walls, black with soot, and the
only light is a sullen red glow from somewhere ahead. The hall leads
west to a round chamber and on east to a bend.

24202.name: A Turn In The Steamy Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Steamy Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Steamy Hallway.

24202.description:
Here the hallway bends hard, and the steam hangs in a thick curtain at
the corner. Rusty water trickles down the outer wall and hisses where it
meets a patch of hot floor. An iron ring is set in the stone, its metal
rubbed bright by the pull of many chains. The passage leads west back
along the hall and south into more steam.

24203.name: The Steamy Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Turn In The Steamy Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Steamy Hallway.

24203.description:
Condensation makes the walls of this stretch slick, and every footprint
fades in the damp almost as soon as it is made. A grating in the floor
breathes out scalding puffs at a steady rhythm, like a sleeper's breath.
Flecks of faded paint cling to the plaster, the last trace of someone's
idea of decoration. The hall goes north to a bend and south toward a
further stretch of steam.

24204.name: The Steamy Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Steamy Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Under The Trapdoor.

24204.description:
The hallway ends in a square of dark planks set into the floor, a heavy
trapdoor whose ring pull has gone black with soot. Steam seeps up
through its cracks, and the wood is hot enough to sting the palm. The
ceiling shimmers with heat, and the stone sweats without pause. The hall
runs back north, and the trapdoor opens down onto a stair.

extra_descs.trapdoor ring pull:
The trapdoor is thick planking bound with iron straps. Its ring pull is
black with soot, and heat comes up through the gaps around it.

24206.name: Under The Trapdoor

up.description: To the up lies The Steamy Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies The Base Of The Stairs.

24206.description:
You stand on a cramped landing just below the trapdoor, where a square
of dim light shows overhead. The ledge is hot, its stone crusted with
yellow brimstone that flakes under your boots. Worn steps drop away from
here into a reddish gloom. A faint hiss of steam comes up from the
depths, and the air smells of struck matches.

24207.name: The Base Of The Stairs

east.description: To the east lies A Cave Passage.

south.description: To the south lies A Tri-Section.

up.description: To the up lies Under The Trapdoor.

24207.description:
The stairs end in a wide landing scuffed by countless bare feet and the
drag of heavy chains. Red light pulses on the walls from some distant
furnace, and the air is dry enough to crack the lips. A cave passage
opens east, and another opening leads south to a junction of tunnels.
The stairs climb up toward the trapdoor above.

24208.name: A Cave Passage

south.description: To the south lies A Tri-Section.

west.description: To the west lies The Base Of The Stairs.

up.description: To the up lies A Small Room At The Top Of The Incline.

24208.description:
This passage is a rough tube of red-brown rock, low enough that taller
travellers must stoop. Fine grey ash carpets the floor and stirs in the
hot draught. The way runs west to the foot of the stairs and south to a
junction of passages. A steep incline of loose gravel climbs up toward a
small room cut high in the rock.

24209.name: A Small Room At The Top Of The Incline

down.description: To the down lies A Cave Passage.

24209.description:
A small room is cut high in the cavern wall at the top of the incline, a
refuge from the heat below. Its floor is bare rock, strewn with scraps
of straw and a tangle of old rope. The air is cooler here, though only
by a little. The incline slopes down to the passage.

24210.name: A Tri-Section

north.description: To the north lies The Base Of The Stairs.

east.description: To the east lies A Tri-Section.

south.description: To the south lies A Cave Passage.

24210.description:
A second tri-section opens here, where tunnel mouths cut the rock in
three directions. Scrapes and scuffs mark the floor from the passage of
heavy loads. The ceiling is blackened, and the smell of old smoke hangs
in the warm air. Passages lead north toward the stairs, east to another
junction, and south to a winding passage.

24211.name: A Tri-Section

north.description: To the north lies A Cave Passage.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Tri-Section.

24211.description:
Three passages meet here in a ragged knot, the stone between them worn
smooth by many passing feet. Soot has stained the ceiling black above a
charred patch where someone once kept a fire. A trickle of warm water
runs along the wall and vanishes into a crack. Tunnels lead north to a
cave passage, west to another junction, and south into a wide cavern.

24212.name: A Cave Passage

north.description: To the north lies A Tri-Section.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

24212.description:
The passage winds between walls of folded red-brown rock, rippled like
melted wax. Pockets of black soot streak the ceiling above, and a patch
of yellow sulphur crusts a crevice. The air is warm and gritty to
breathe. The passage leads north to a tri-section and east into a large
cavern.

24213.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Tri-Section.

south.description: To the south lies In a Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Cave Passage.

down.description: To the down lies The Hidden Room.

24213.description:
The passage opens into a great cavern whose ceiling is lost in a hot red
haze. Stalactites hang like rows of dark teeth, and some drip warm brown
water onto the broken floor. Rubble and snapped tools lie where slaves
once hauled stone. Passages lead north and west, a long hallway opens
south, and a ragged hole in the floor drops down to a hidden chamber.

24214.name: The Hidden Room

up.description: To the up lies A Large Cavern.

24214.description:
This hidden room is a pocket in the rock, reached only by a hole in the
cavern ceiling above. The walls have been smoothed by hand, and a rough
bench is hewn into one side. Tiny scraps of cloth and an old clay lamp
lie in the dust. A way leads up to the large cavern.

24215.name: In a Long Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In a Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies In the Long Hallway.

24215.description:
This hallway is straight and finely built, its walls of dressed stone
sweating in the heat. Bronze sconces hold only cold embers and leave
long soot streaks up the plaster. The flagstones are worn smooth down
the middle by generations of marching feet. The cavern lies north, and
the hallway runs on east and west.

24216.name: In a Long Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Enormous Room.

east.description: To the east lies The East End of the Long Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies In a Long Hallway.

24216.description:
A heavy door of black-banded oak stands in the north wall here, scorched
along its edges. The floor is gritty with ash blown in whenever it is
opened, and faint orange light pulses beneath it. The wood is warm to
the touch. The hallway continues east to its end and west toward a
junction.

24217.name: In the Long Hallway

east.description: To the east lies In a Long Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Large Room.

west.description: To the west lies The West End of the Long Hallway.

24217.description:
This is the middle of the long hallway, where arched recesses mark the
walls at even spaces and hold nothing but soot. The stone of the floor
is cracked with heat and polished by passing feet. Smoke stains the
vaulted ceiling in drifting patterns. The hall runs east and west, and a
door south leads into a large room.

24218.name: The Enormous Room

south.description: To the south lies In a Long Hallway.

24218.description:
This enormous room swallows the light, its ceiling so far above that it
is only a darkness patterned with faint red cracks. Pillars of fused
black glass stand in rows, each as thick as an ancient oak and ringed
with scorch marks. The floor is a field of tumbled flagstones and heaps
of cold slag. The only way out is the door south, back to the hallway.

24219.name: The East End of the Long Hallway

west.description: To the west lies In a Long Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies The Top Of The Vertical Shaft.

24219.description:
The hallway ends at a blank wall of sooty stone that bears the ghostly
outline of a bricked-up arch. A round opening in the floor, rimmed with
iron staples, drops into a hot darkness, and rusted rungs lead down into
it. Heat boils up from the hole until the air wavers. The only other way
is west along the hall.

24220.name: The Large Room

north.description: To the north lies In the Long Hallway.

24220.description:
This large room is a bare hall of rough stone, with long wooden benches
overturned and charred. A hearth as wide as a cart fills one wall, its
grate heaped with ash and half-burnt bones. Scorched tapestries hang in
rags above it. The door north leads back to the hallway.

24221.name: The West End of the Long Hallway

east.description: To the east lies In the Long Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Room.

up.description: To the up lies The Stairs.

24221.description:
The long hallway ends in a high, bare chamber where a staircase of dark
wood rises along the wall. The floor is covered with trampled straw and
scattered chips of charcoal. A door south is bolted with a heavy iron
bar. The hall runs east, and stairs climb up.

24222.name: A Small Room

north.description: To the north lies The West End of the Long Hallway.

24222.description:
A small room, cluttered and close, is lined with shelves stacked with
brittle scrolls and cracked jars. Soot has coated every surface, leaving
a fine black dust over all. The air is hot and thick with the smell of
cinders. The only way out is the door north.

24223.name: The Stairs

east.description: To the east lies The Bedroom.

down.description: To the down lies The West End of the Long Hallway.

24223.description:
The wooden stairs creak under every footfall and are worn to a dip in
each tread. A rope serves as handrail, fraying where it passes through
iron eyes. Heat gathers at the top, and the smell of old perfume drifts
down. The stairs lead down to the hallway, and an opening east leads to
a bedroom.

24224.name: The Bedroom

east.description: To the east lies The Secret Space.

west.description: To the west lies The Stairs.

24224.description:
A great bed with posts of carved black wood dominates this bedroom, its
curtains scorched into brown lace. A dressing table stands cracked and
dull with grime, its mirror long since blistered black. Fine ash covers
the rugs. A door east conceals a secret space, and the stairs lie west.

24225.name: The Secret Space

west.description: To the west lies The Bedroom.

24225.description:
This cramped secret space is hardly bigger than a closet, its walls
stuffed with cobwebs and soot. A small iron-bound chest stands empty in
the corner, its lock burst open. The air is thick and still, and the
heat makes the walls tick. The only way out is west, through the
bedroom.

24226.name: The Top Of The Vertical Shaft

east.description: To the east lies A Royal Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Base of the Ruined Stairs.

up.description: To the up lies The East End of the Long Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies The Vertical Shaft.

24226.description:
You stand on a ledge at the rim of an immense vertical shaft whose black
throat drops out of sight below. Hot air gusts up from it, carrying a
dull red glow and a smell of burning. A rotten timber rail hangs half
collapsed along the lip. Passages lead east into a royal hallway and
west to a ruined stair, and iron rungs climb up to the long hallway.

24227.name: A Royal Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Turn In The Royal Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Top Of The Vertical Shaft.

24227.description:
The floor of this hallway is laid with black and crimson tiles, cracked
by heat but still arranged in a proud pattern. Carved pillars line the
walls, their faces the grinning visages of fire kings long dead.
Tattered banners of scorched silk droop from iron poles. The hall bends
north, and west it opens onto the rim of a great pit.

24228.name: A Turn In The Royal Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Royal Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Royal Hallway.

24228.description:
At this bend the royal hallway narrows, and a mosaic of tiny red tiles
shows a figure crowned in flames. Many tiles have popped from the floor
in the heat, leaving pits full of ash. The air is oven-hot, smelling of
spice and smoke. The hall leads east toward a grander stretch and south
back to its start.

extra_descs.mosaic figure:
The mosaic shows a tall figure wreathed in flame, standing over a ring
of kneeling slaves. Its eyes are chips of red glass that catch the
light.

24229.name: A Royal Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance To The Throne Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn In The Royal Hallway.

24229.description:
Gilded sconces of twisted bronze flank this stretch of the royal
hallway, each holding a gout of fire that never gutters. Gold leaf on
the walls has blistered and peeled in the heat. A strip of carpet, once
crimson and now the colour of dried blood, runs down the middle of the
floor. The hall leads west to a bend and east to an imposing entrance.

24230.name: The Entrance To The Throne Room

north.description: To the north lies The Huge Throne Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Royal Hallway.

24230.description:
Two enormous bronze doors, cast with scenes of cities in flames, mark
the entrance to the throne room. The north door stands ajar, and a
roaring heat pours through the gap. Scorched guard alcoves flank the
doorway, their floors black with old grease and ash. The royal hallway
leads back west.

24231.name: The Huge Throne Room

north.description: To the north lies The Secret Treasure Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance To The Throne Room.

24231.description:
A vast hall of black basalt opens around you, its ceiling hung with
chains of glowing iron. At the far end rises a throne of fused slag and
red iron, its arms carved as snarling wolves, and before it glows a wide
trench of coals. Heat presses on you like a hand. The door south leads
back to the entrance, and a narrow door behind the throne opens north.

extra_descs.throne:
The throne is a single mass of fused slag and iron, its seat worn
smooth. Its arms end in the snarling heads of wolves, whose open mouths
hold small fires.

24232.name: The Secret Treasure Room

south.description: To the south lies The Huge Throne Room.

24232.description:
This hidden room is a bare vault of dark rock lined with stone shelves,
nearly all of them emptied long ago. Heavy iron chests stand open along
the walls, their lids twisted by heat and their locks hacked away. Ash
lies deep and undisturbed in the corners. The only way out is the door
south, back to the throne room.

24233.name: The Base of the Ruined Stairs

east.description: To the east lies The Top Of The Vertical Shaft.

up.description: To the up lies Entrance To The Dark Tunnels.

24233.description:
A flight of ruined stairs climbs from here into the dark, half its steps
cracked and slumped into rubble. The landing is littered with fallen
stone, and a thin crust of white salt gleams on the walls. The way east
returns to the rim of the great pit, and the broken stairs go up toward
a tunnel mouth.

24234.name: Entrance To The Dark Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Clearing.

down.description: To the down lies The Base of the Ruined Stairs.

24234.description:
The ruined stairs end at the mouth of a tunnel system, where the walls
close in and the red glow below fades to nothing. Tool marks scar the
rock, and burnt-out torch stubs lie crusted to the floor. Tunnels lead
north into the dark, a small clearing opens east, and the broken stairs
go down.

24235.name: A Small Clearing

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Junction.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Dark Tunnels.

24235.description:
The tunnels widen into a small clearing of packed earth and flat rock,
the only open space for some distance. A ring of blackened stones marks
an old hearth, and a few rags hang from pegs driven into the wall. The
air is warm and smells of cold ash. A junction lies north of here, and
the tunnels of the entrance run west.

24236.name: A Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Junction.

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Junction.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Dark Tunnels.

24236.description:
The tunnel is narrow and utterly dark, its walls pressing close and its
floor sloping unevenly underfoot. Dry grit crunches with every step, and
the air is warm and dead. Faint scratches in the rock look like tally
marks made by many hands. Passages meet here at a junction north and
east, while south the tunnel runs back to the stairs.

24237.name: A Dark Junction

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

24237.description:
This junction is a rough crossing of dark tunnels, their mouths gaping
like open throats in the rock. A pool of congealed wax shows where a
candle once guttered out on a flat stone. Warm air drifts in from the
crawlway of bones. Ways lead east into that crawlway, south to a small
clearing, and west along a tunnel.

24238.name: A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Junction.

24238.description:
The crawlway of bones turns here in a tight bend, its floor a crunching
mat of ribs and splintered long bones. Scorch marks blacken a few of the
larger skulls set into the wall. The air is hot and still, with a sour
tang of char. The crawlway leads north to a further length of itself,
and west to a dark junction.

24239.name: A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

south.description: To the south lies A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Junction.

24239.description:
This crawlway is paved with old bones, ground to splinters underfoot and
packed into the cracks of the rock. The ceiling presses low, forcing you
to stoop, and the dry air tastes of chalk. Skulls peer from small niches
in the walls. A narrow passage leads north into a maze of caverns, south
along the crawlway, and west to a junction.

24240.name: The Maze Of Confusing Caverns

south.description: To the south lies A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones.

north.description: To the north lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

24240.description:
A bewildering cluster of low caverns opens here, each hollow leading
into three more, and the red glow of the fire seems to come from every
side at once. Stone knobs and ridges break the walls into confusing
shapes. Heat shimmers over the floor. The only certain way out is the
crawlway of bones south.

24241.name: The Maze Of Confusing Caverns

south.description: To the south lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

north.description: To the north lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

24241.description:
The maze twists into a hollow where the walls bulge in smooth, glowing
blisters of stone. Every path seems to bend back on itself, and heat
shimmers over the floor in confusing ripples. Marks scratched on the
rock by earlier wanderers have been smudged out. The caverns offer no
clear way out.

24242.name: The Maze Of Confusing Caverns

south.description: To the south lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

east.description: To the east lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

24242.description:
A low, wide cavern fans out in a dozen directions, each one a dead end
of crumbling rock. The red glow comes from every side and from no side,
making shadows swim. Dust lies in drifts like snow, scored with confused
footprints. There is no clear way out.

24243.name: The Maze Of Confusing Caverns

west.description: To the west lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

east.description: To the east lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

24243.description:
Pillars of stone grow from floor to ceiling here, forming a forest of
rock columns that all look the same. The heat is damp and heavy, and
drops of warm water fall from the roof. Wherever you turn, the same dull
glow shines back. The caverns offer no way out.

24244.name: The Maze Of Confusing Caverns

west.description: To the west lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

east.description: To the east lies A Dead-End.

24244.description:
The cavern floor here slopes into a bowl, and the walls curve up around
it like the inside of a great pot. Streaks of sulphur paint the rock
yellow and orange. A hot breeze circles endlessly without finding a way
out. No marked path leads from this confusing place.

24245.name: A Dead-End

west.description: To the west lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

south.description: To the south lies The Maze Of Confusing Caverns.

24245.description:
This dead end is a pocket of rock closed in on all sides, the walls
blackened by heat and scored with desperate scratches. A scatter of
bones lies in the corner, and the air is hot and unmoving. Whoever came
here came to the end of the maze and found nothing. No way leads on.

24246.name: The Maze Of Confusing Caverns

north.description: To the north lies A Dead-End.

24246.description:
A long, winding cavern ends here in a tangle of rock folds and sagging
ledges. The ceiling drips glassy black beads, and each lands with a tiny
hiss. Stones glow orange at the cracks, and the floor is warm underfoot.
You can see no sure way out.

24247.name: The Room Of Fire
24247.description:
A fierce roar fills this chamber, where fire leaps from vents in the
floor and licks the ceiling in sheets of white and gold. Molten rock
oozes along channels cut in the stone and pools in glowing hollows. The
heat blisters the skin, and the light hurts the eyes. No path leads from
this furnace of the mountain.

24248.name: A Dark Junction

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Crawlway Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

24248.description:
Several tunnels meet at this junction, and the darkness is so complete
that the walls can only be found by touch. The rock here is rough and
dry, pitted with small hollows that hold drifts of pale dust. A narrow
crawlway of bones opens east. Another tunnel runs north, and a third
leads west.

24249.name: A Dark Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Junction.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

24249.description:
The tunnel narrows to a crooked slot, forcing you to turn your shoulders
to pass. Black soot streaks the ceiling where long-gone torches burned.
A faint smell of old smoke lingers in the dead air. The passage leads
south to a junction and west deeper into the dark.

24250.name: A Dark Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Tunnel.

24250.description:
The tunnel ends here at a low door of iron-bound planks set into the
east wall. Deep scratches mark the planks at about waist height, as
though many fingers once clawed at them. The rock floor dips into a
shallow hollow worn by feet. The only way onward is east through the
door.

24251.name: A Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Exit From The Dark Tunnels.

24251.description:
This tunnel is a narrow bore through dark, gritty rock, its floor strewn
with a litter of flaked stone. The air is warm and carries a faint
sulphur stink. Long scratches mark the walls at shoulder height, as if
something dragged a chain along them. The tunnel leads north into
further darkness and south toward an exit from the tunnels.

24252.name: A Dark Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Tunnel.

24252.description:
The tunnel bends sharply here, and the roof sags so low that you must
duck to pass. Pale mineral streaks run through the rock like veins in an
old hand. A stub of candle, melted to a puddle, clings to a ledge.
Passages lead east into a dark tunnel and south to a straighter stretch.

24253.name: Exit From The Dark Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Very Small Crawlspace.

up.description: To the up lies On The Spiral Staircase.

24253.description:
The tunnels end at a broken landing where the rock gives way to a ring
of worked stone. Narrow iron stairs spiral up from its centre, black and
slick with condensation. Warm draughts rise along them from some far-off
furnace. A tunnel leads north back into the dark, a very small
crawlspace opens east, and the spiral climbs up.

24254.name: A Very Small Crawlspace

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Exit From The Dark Tunnels.

24254.description:
You must crawl on hands and knees through this tiny burrow of dry rock,
the ceiling scraping your back. Bits of old bone crunch under your
palms, and the air is stale and thick. Faint red light shows at one end
of the squeeze and total darkness at the other. The crawlspace leads
east toward a dark tunnel and west to the tunnels' exit.

24255.name: On The Spiral Staircase

up.description: To the up lies The Top of the Spiral Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies Exit From The Dark Tunnels.

24255.description:
A narrow iron staircase winds tightly around a central pillar here, its
steps cold-forged and worn hollow in the middle. The rail is slick with
moisture, and heat rises along it from below. Faint tapping echoes down
the pillar from above. The stair goes up toward a landing and down to
the tunnels.

24256.name: The Top of the Spiral Staircase

west.description: To the west lies The Strange Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies On The Spiral Staircase.

24256.description:
The spiral staircase ends at a small round landing floored in cracked
marble. A sooty niche in the pillar holds a bronze lamp, long since out
of oil. The air is dry and strangely perfumed with old incense. The
stair winds down, and a doorway leads west into a hallway.

24257.name: The Strange Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Top of the Spiral Staircase.

west.description: To the west lies The Strange Room.

24257.description:
This hallway is short and crooked, its walls painted with bands of faded
colours that make no pattern the eye can follow. Doors that are not
doors, mere outlines in the plaster, line the sides. The floor tilts
slightly, as if the whole passage had settled over centuries. It runs
east to the stair landing and west to a stranger room.

24258.name: The Strange Room

east.description: To the east lies The Strange Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies The Sphere Room.

24258.description:
Nothing in this room sits quite right: the corners meet at wrong angles
and the ceiling slopes toward a different side than the floor does. Pale
lines are inlaid in the stone in a spiral that draws the eye round and
round. A faint thrum comes up from the floor, and the air smells of hot
metal. The hallway lies east, and a round hole in the floor leads down.

24259.name: The Vertical Shaft

south.description: To the south lies The Endless Fall.

up.description: To the up lies The Top Of The Vertical Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies The Vertical Shaft.

24259.description:
You cling to the wall of a vertical shaft that plunges down into red
darkness. Rusted iron rungs are set into the rock, spaced for long arms,
and they tremble when you grip them. Hot wind pours up past you with a
hollow roar. The rungs lead up to the rim and down into the glow, and a
gap in the wall opens south onto empty air.

24260.name: The Vertical Shaft

south.description: To the south lies The Endless Fall.

west.description: To the west lies The Platform.

up.description: To the up lies The Vertical Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies The Vertical Shaft.

24260.description:
The shaft here is wider, its rock wall pocked with ledges and old iron
pitons driven in by those who worked this place. A cold green seep
trails down the stone, hissing where it touches the hot rungs. Great
breaths of heat roll past from below. A platform lies west, the rungs
lead up and down, and a gap opens south onto the void.

24261.name: The Vertical Shaft

east.description: To the east lies The Dirty Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Endless Fall.

up.description: To the up lies The Vertical Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies The Endless Fall.

24261.description:
The shaft bottoms out in a narrow throat, where the rock glows a dull
red and the heat is almost unbearable. A brittle crust of cinders covers
every ledge. Below, the endless fall is a pit of fire, and the wall
opens south onto it. A way leads east to a dirty room, and the rungs
climb up the shaft.

24262.name: The Dirty Room

west.description: To the west lies The Vertical Shaft.

24262.description:
This dirty room has a floor of caked mud and ash, trodden into hard
ridges by dragging feet. Bits of broken pottery and rags lie in the
corners, and the walls are smeared with black fingerprints. The air is
hot and heavy, with a smell of burnt hair. The only way out is west,
back to the shaft.

24263.name: The Endless Fall

north.description: To the north lies The Vertical Shaft.

24263.description:
There is no floor here, no wall, nothing but heat and a rushing roar as
you plunge through a vast red emptiness. Sparks stream past like upward-
falling stars, and the wind tears at your clothes. Far below, a glow
waits patiently. The fall goes on and on, and the only thing to be done
is to flail for any hold.

24264.name: The Platform

east.description: To the east lies The Vertical Shaft.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rope Bridge.

24264.description:
A platform of massive timbers juts from the cavern wall, bolted into the
rock with iron straps gone dark with age. The planks are charred and
sticky with pitch, and the whole structure groans under your weight.
Beyond the edge a gulf of red light yawns. East lies the shaft, and west
a rope bridge sets out across the gulf.

24265.name: On The Rope Bridge

east.description: To the east lies The Platform.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rope Bridge.

24265.description:
The rope bridge sways beneath you, its planks gapped and furred with
soot. Thick hemp cables, singed brown, run to rope rails at either side.
Updraughts of hot air tug at your cloak, and below a red glow pulses
like a vast eye. Solid footing lies east at the platform, and the bridge
continues west.

24266.name: On The Rope Bridge

east.description: To the east lies On The Rope Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rope Bridge.

24266.description:
At the middle of the bridge, the sway is worst, and each step sends a
shiver through the cables. A few planks are missing, showing the gulf
beneath in glimpses of molten orange. The rope rails are frayed and
greasy under the hand. Heat from below makes your eyes water. The bridge
runs east and west from here.

24267.name: On The Rope Bridge

east.description: To the east lies On The Rope Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies The Platform.

24267.description:
The far side of the bridge is close, and the cables here are bolted to a
stone anchor-post hung with iron hooks. The planks are newer and
sturdier, though still scorched. Faint clanging of metal on metal drifts
across the gulf. The bridge leads east back across the gulf, and west it
reaches a platform.

24269.name: The Platform

north.description: To the north lies On The Dangerous Ledge.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rope Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies Outside the Massive Gate.

down.description: To the down lies On The Tiny Corner.

24269.description:
This broad stone platform is a junction of ways, its floor scored by the
wheels of heavy carts and the drag of chains. A cable winch with a
rusted handle stands near the edge. The air is dry and furnace-hot, and
ahead the cavern wall is pierced by gateways. A narrow ledge climbs
north, a massive gate stands west, the bridge runs east, and a steep
stair drops down to a tiny corner.

24270.name: On The Tiny Corner

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Corridor.

up.description: To the up lies The Platform.

24270.description:
A slender ledge of rock forms a tiny corner here, tucked under the
platform's overhang and half hidden from view. Heat ripples off the
cliff, and a thread of smoke curls from a crack. A plain door of dark
wood is set in the wall, painted the same colour as the stone. It leads
west into a hidden corridor, and a steep stair climbs up to the
platform.

24271.name: The Secret Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Secret Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tiny Corner.

24271.description:
This corridor is cramped and bare, its walls close enough to touch both
at once. Dust lies on the floor in an even, undisturbed film, and the
plaster has fallen away in patches. A faint smell of sweet spice mingles
with the scent of hot metal. The corridor turns north, and a door east
leads out to a tiny corner.

24272.name: The Secret Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Machk-Gyi's Treasure Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies The Secret Corridor.

24272.description:
The corridor ends in a square little chamber fitted with a heavy door of
riveted bronze, locked by many bolts. Faint red light glows in its
seams, and scrapes mark the floor where the door has been pulled open
and shut. The air here is hotter than anywhere nearby. The corridor runs
south, and the bronze door leads east.

24273.name: Machk-Gyi's Treasure Chambers

north.description: To the north lies Machk-Gyi's Inner Treasury.

east.description: To the east lies Machk-Gyi's Inner Treasury.

south.description: To the south lies Machk-Gyi's Inner Treasury.

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Corridor.

24273.description:
Four doors open off this vaulted chamber, and the whole room glitters
with the reflections of treasure. Gold veins run through the walls,
polished to a mirror shine, and the floor is inlaid with a great
sunburst of crimson stone. The heat is almost solid. Doors lead north,
east and south to inner treasuries, and the corridor lies west.

24274.name: Machk-Gyi's Inner Treasury

south.description: To the south lies Machk-Gyi's Treasure Chambers.

24274.description:
Piles of ancient wealth lie heaped in this vault: tarnished goblets,
heavy bars of ruddy gold, and chests spilled open to show tumbled
jewels. Everything glows faintly from the heat, and the air ripples in
front of your eyes. A throne-like chair of black iron sits at the far
end. The only door leads south, back to the treasure chambers.

24275.name: Machk-Gyi's Inner Treasury

north.description: To the north lies Machk-Gyi's Treasure Chambers.

24275.description:
Great urns of beaten bronze fill this vault, each larger than a man and
brimming with coins fused into solid lumps. Between them stand idols of
molten glass, their features melting and re-forming slowly. The air
smells of hot metal and incense. A door leads north to the treasure
chambers.

24276.name: Machk-Gyi's Inner Treasury

west.description: To the west lies Machk-Gyi's Treasure Chambers.

24276.description:
Racks of weapons stand in rows in this vault, their blades glowing a
dull cherry red and never cooling. Shields hang on hooks, the faces of
their emblems blistered. The floor is paved with gold plate, and the
heat roars against the face. A door leads west to the treasure chambers.

24277.name: On The Dangerous Ledge

south.description: To the south lies The Platform.

west.description: To the west lies The Fire Gigas Hideout.

24277.description:
A dangerous ledge no wider than a man's shoulders clings to the cavern
wall here, crumbling at its outer edge. Loose pebbles skitter off it and
are lost in the glow below. Smoke wreathes the rock, and the heat seems
to push at your back. The ledge runs south to the platform and west
toward a hideout.

24278.name: The Fire Gigas Hideout

east.description: To the east lies On The Dangerous Ledge.

24278.description:
This high cavern is a lair for something huge, its floor heaped with
bones of cattle and men. Enormous stone benches have been dragged
together to make crude seats, and a gigantic anvil stands blackened in a
corner. Soot lies thick on the roof, and the air stinks of sweat and
burnt hair. The only way out is the ledge east.

extra_descs.anvil:
The anvil is bigger than a farm cart, its face dented by blows from some
enormous hammer. The iron still glows faintly.

24279.name: Outside the Massive Gate

east.description: To the east lies The Platform.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the Massive Gate.

24279.description:
A massive gate of black iron rises here, its twin leaves studded with
spikes the length of a forearm. Heaps of cinder and old bone lie drifted
against the base, and the stone around it is polished by shoulders
pressing at it. Red firelight leaks from the cracks. The platform lies
east, and a small door set in the gate leads west.

extra_descs.gate massive iron spikes:
The gate is black iron on iron hinges as thick as a man's waist. Its
spikes are blunted and stained, and a small door is cut into the bottom
of the western leaf.

24280.name: Inside the Massive Gate

north.description: To the north lies The Prison.

east.description: To the east lies Outside the Massive Gate.

south.description: To the south lies The Prison.

west.description: To the west lies The Slave Path.

24280.description:
You are just inside the massive gate, in a high guardroom where chains
and shackles hang in clusters from the walls. The air is a stifling mix
of sweat, smoke and burnt iron. Whip marks score the pillars at head
height, and a trough of scummy water stands against the wall. Ways lead
out north and south into the prison, west along a slave path, and east
through the gate.

extra_descs.shackles chains:
The shackles hang in long rows from the walls, their cuffs of different
sizes. Some are worn thin, and some are still bright with use.

24281.name: The Prison

north.description: To the north lies Inside the Massive Gate.

east.description: To the east lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

south.description: To the south lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

west.description: To the west lies The Prison.

24281.description:
The prison hall forks here, its floor trodden to a hollow groove by the
slow pacing of guards. A rack of rusted shackles hangs on the wall
beside a bucket of oily water, and the air is dense with sweat and
smoke. Iron doors lead east and south into cells. The gate lies north,
and the hall runs west.

24282.name: The Prison

north.description: To the north lies The Slave Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Prison.

south.description: To the south lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

24282.description:
This prison hall is wide and low, its barred alcoves stuffed with filthy
straw. Rows of iron rings are set at ankle height along the walls,
polished by shifting prisoners. The air is oppressive with heat, and
drops of sweat fall from the roof like rain. The slave path lies north,
the hall continues east, and an iron door south leads to a cell.

24283.name: The Slave Path

north.description: To the north lies The Slave Path.

east.description: To the east lies Inside the Massive Gate.

south.description: To the south lies The Prison.

24283.description:
The slave path ends its long run at a wide crossing near the gate, the
floor trampled hard by many feet. Soot-black pillars are chipped where
chains have been struck against them. A cold draught finds its way in
from somewhere, a rare relief in the heat. A way east leads back to the
gate, north runs the path, and south opens onto the prison.

24284.name: The Slave Path

north.description: To the north lies The Slave Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Prison.

south.description: To the south lies The Slave Path.

24284.description:
The slave path bends here between the sooty walls, its floor scuffed to
a polished sheen. A trough of dark, cooling oil stands against the wall,
and old whips of braided hide hang from pegs. The roof is low and the
heat builds. The path runs north and south, and an opening east gives
onto the prison.

24285.name: The Slave Path

north.description: To the north lies The Path of Bones.

east.description: To the east lies The Prison.

south.description: To the south lies The Slave Path.

24285.description:
A hard-packed path runs along this stretch, scuffed by the shuffle of
bare, shackled feet. A groove worn in the floor marks where chains have
dragged for years. Smoke-grey light seeps from fissures in the walls,
and a low moaning draught carries the stink of the prison. The path
leads north to a bone-littered track and south along its length, and an
opening east gives onto the prison.

24286.name: The Prison

north.description: To the north lies The Prison.

east.description: To the east lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

south.description: To the south lies Inside the Massive Gate.

west.description: To the west lies The Slave Path.

24286.description:
This stretch of prison is a long, dim hall lined with iron-barred
alcoves, each strewn with rotted straw. Manacles on short chains hang
from the walls, their cuffs worn thin by wrists. The stone is greasy
with sweat and soot. A door to the east leads to a cell, the hall
continues north, a slave path lies west, and the gate lies south.

24287.name: The Prison

north.description: To the north lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

east.description: To the east lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

south.description: To the south lies The Prison.

west.description: To the west lies The Slave Path.

24287.description:
The hall of the prison ends in a close, hot corner where the ceiling
hangs low and sooty. Rusty tools for punishment hang from hooks: a
barbed lash, a cage, tongs black with old heat. Doors of iron bars lead
north and east into cells. A slave path runs west, and the hall returns
south.

24288.name: The Path of Bones

north.description: To the north lies The Giant Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Slave Path.

24288.description:
Bones lie scattered thick along this path, picked clean and cracked for
marrow, some still bound to rusty shackle-rings. The walls are black
with long smoke. A crunch of splinters follows your every step, and the
heat is steady and heavy. The way leads north to a great cavern and
south to the slave path.

24289.name: The Giant Cavern

north.description: To the north lies The Magnificent Silver Vault.

south.description: To the south lies The Path of Bones.

24289.description:
This giant cavern is floored with smooth, glassy black rock that glints
with a thousand tiny reflections of red fire. Immense columns of stone
rise to a vaulted roof hidden in smoke. The only sound is a deep,
distant rumble, as of a heart beating in the mountain. A door of silver-
plated steel stands in the north wall, and the path of bones lies south.

24290.name: The Magnificent Silver Vault

south.description: To the south lies The Giant Cavern.

24290.description:
This vault is lined with polished silver plate that throws back a
warped, flickering image of everything within. Empty plinths and open
caskets stand in rows, and every shelf is stripped bare. The heat has
darkened the silver to the colour of old pewter. A reek of sulphur hangs
in the air, and the only exit is the door south.

extra_descs.silver plate plating:
The silver plating is beaten thin and fitted in overlapping panels over
the stone. The heat has tarnished it, but it still returns a dim,
wavering reflection.

24291.name: A Smelly Prison Cell

west.description: To the west lies The Prison.

24291.description:
This cell is a narrow stone box with a ledge for a bed and a slop bucket
crusted with filth. Bars of old burn-marks streak the walls where hot
irons were laid against the stone. A few lice-ridden rags lie scattered.
The only way out is the door west, onto the prison hall.

24292.name: A Smelly Prison Cell

north.description: To the north lies The Prison.

24292.description:
A heap of black straw fills one corner of this cell, and a tin bowl lies
bent flat on the floor. The ceiling is so low that a tall prisoner could
not stand upright, and the walls weep a greasy damp. A thin voice of
wind whistles through a crack. The door north leads out to the prison
hall.

24293.name: A Smelly Prison Cell

north.description: To the north lies The Prison.

24293.description:
Tally marks climb the walls of this cell in thousands of tiny scratches,
ending in a spray of angry gouges. The floor is bare stone, worn into a
shallow dish at its centre. The air is close and fevered, and sweat runs
down the stone. The only way out is the door north, to the prison hall.

24294.name: A Smelly Prison Cell

west.description: To the west lies The Prison.

24294.description:
Heavy chains dangle from the ceiling of this cell, ending in iron cuffs
hung at just above head height. Dried stains darken the floor beneath
them. The cell is hot as a baker's oven, and the walls tick faintly as
they cool and warm. The door west returns to the prison hall.

24295.name: A Smelly Prison Cell

south.description: To the south lies The Prison.

24295.description:
This cramped cell has no light but the red glow seeping under the door.
A heap of rotted straw lies in one corner beside a bucket stained with
filth, and names are scratched into the walls in rows. The stones are
damp and sticky, and the stench is thick enough to chew. The door south
leads back to the prison.

24296.name: A Smelly Prison Cell

west.description: To the west lies The Prison.

down.description: To the down lies The Giant Cavern.

24296.description:
A trapdoor-sized hole gapes in the middle of this smelly cell, its edges
worn smooth by rope. Chains lie in a heap near it, and the walls are
scorched with the shapes of splayed hands. The stink of sweat and old
fear is strong. The prison lies west, and the hole drops down to a lower
cavern.

24297.name: The Giant Cavern

up.description: To the up lies A Smelly Prison Cell.

24297.description:
A huge, high cavern opens beneath the prison, its walls stained red-
orange by the glow from fissures in the rock. Cart tracks wind across
the floor to a heap of broken ore baskets, and iron winches stand like
gallows overhead. Hot, sulphur-laden air presses on the lungs. A rope
hangs from the hole above, leading up to a cell.

647800.name: slave cinder prisoner
647800.long_desc: A cinder-scarred slave shuffles here, eyes down, dragging a length of broken chain.
647800.description:
This gaunt slave is burnt and blistered across the shoulders, with old
whip welts crossing the burns. Rags hang from a frame worn to bone. The
eyes that meet yours are dull with exhaustion.

647801.name: ember imp fire demon
647801.long_desc: A flickering ember imp scampers along the floor, spitting sparks and cackling.
647801.description:
The imp is a hunched little demon no larger than a child, its skin the
glossy black of cooling slag and cracked with orange fire. Tiny horns
curl from its brow, and its grin shows teeth like hot needles. Smoke
curls from its nostrils.

647802.name: cinder spider fire
647802.long_desc: A huge cinder spider clings to the rock, its legs glowing faintly at the joints.
647802.description:
The spider is as big as a dog, its carapace the grey of old ash and its
leg joints glowing a sullen red. Heat pulses off its swollen body in
waves. Its eyes are small beads of molten glass.

647803.name: overseer guard slaver whip
647803.long_desc: A whip-scarred overseer paces here, a barbed lash coiled on his hip.
647803.description:
This broad, heavy guard has skin like baked leather, ridged with old
burns, and eyes that glow a faint orange. A barbed lash hangs at his
belt, and he wears a collar of studded iron. He regards every living
thing as a beast to be driven.

647804.name: royal flame guard fire soldier
647804.long_desc: A royal flame guard stands rigid here in armour of blackened bronze, flames licking at its helm.
647804.description:
The guard is a tall figure of living fire clad in bronze plate, its
visor pierced by two glowing slits. It bears a heavy shield stamped with
a burning crown, and its movements make the air around it shimmer. It
does not speak.

647805.name: magma ogre brute
647805.long_desc: A hulking magma ogre lumbers here, trailing smoke from its cracked, glowing hide.
647805.description:
This ogre stands twice a man's height, its hide a lattice of black crust
over a molten glow. Each step leaves a scorched print, and its fists are
slabs of cooled rock. Steam hisses from the seams of its shoulders.

647806.name: gorrak fire gigas giant
647806.long_desc: Gorrak, the fire gigas, squats here among the bones, a hammer as long as a man resting across his knees.
647806.description:
Gorrak is a giant of ember-red skin, thickly muscled and scarred across
the chest by a lifetime of fights. His beard is braided with iron rings,
and smoke rolls from his shoulders as he breathes. He guards the ledge
for Machk-Gyi.

647807.name: machk-gyi machk gyi fire lord demon
647807.long_desc: Machk-Gyi, the fire lord, towers here amid his hoard, wreathed in a crown of living flame.
647807.description:
Machk-Gyi is a towering lord of fire, his body a furnace of white-hot
muscle caged in blackened iron plate. A crown of flames burns on his
brow, and his voice is the crack of a whip over a roaring forge. Gold
melts and runs at his feet.

747800.name: shackle iron cracked
747800.room_desc: A cracked iron shackle lies here.
747800.description: A heavy iron wrist shackle, snapped at the hinge. The inside is polished by years of wearing.

747801.name: lash whip barbed cinder
747801.room_desc: A cinder-barbed lash lies coiled here.
747801.description: A long lash of braided hide, studded with barbs of blackened iron. The tips still smoulder faintly.

747802.name: shield bronze flame crown
747802.short_desc: a bronze shield stamped with a burning crown
747802.room_desc: A bronze shield stamped with a burning crown lies here.
747802.description: A round shield of heavy bronze, still warm to the touch. A burning crown is stamped in its face.

747803.name: hammer gigas iron huge
747803.room_desc: A huge gigas hammer lies here, glowing at the head.
747803.description: A hammer forged for a giant, its iron head still glowing dull red. The haft is bound in cord blackened by many hands.

747804.name: crown fire lord iron flame
747804.short_desc: the crown of the fire lord
747804.room_desc: A crown of black iron lies here, flickering with embers.
747804.description: A band of black iron set with spikes of red glass, each flickering as though lit by a coal within. It is always warm.
